chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, and Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father, all from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who is given the zakat to distribute: Is it permissible for him to take something from it from the city he is in to another? He (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem.
ai.seo_question: Can zakat money collected in one city be distributed in another city?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of zakat distribution, establishing that a recipient entrusted with funds in one city is permitted to transfer and distribute them in another, highlighting the flexibility of the 'poor' (fuqara) category. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that zakat is not strictly bound to the immediate locality of collection if it serves the broader interest of the recipients, a nuance often discussed in contrast to stricter Hanafi or Maliki positions on local retention.
